title: Soup fine-tunes large language models on low VRAM GPUs #shorts #soup #vram
description: Soup, developed by solo Kazakh developer Alpamys Makajan, revolutionizes fine-tuning large language models by eliminating the need for expensive cloud GPUs and complex setups. This open-source tool enables anyone to fine-tune models like Llama with a simple YAML configuration and a single command, streamlining a process that once required extensive resources and expertise. The core innovation behind Soup is as-layer streaming, which loads and trains one model layer at a time instead of all at once, reducing VRAM requirements drastically—from 16 GB to just 3.3 GB. This enables fine-tuning on consumer-grade hardware, demonstrated by a run on a 4 GB laptop GPU achieving 119 tokens per second. Soup’s accessible approach represents a significant step toward truly democratized AI development. #SoupAI #AlpamysMakajan #FineTuning #LlamaModel #OpenSourceAI #AsLayerStreaming #AIInnovation #DemocratizedAI #MachineLearning #LowVRAMTraining #HackerNews #SoloDeveloper #AItools #ConsumerAI #AIsoftware
